notes.title: Our 3rd Title Goosey Guess Is Available Now
notes.content:
Gas Lantern Games has released our 3rd title Goosey Guess. It is available on steam now! If you are interested in trying Goosey Guess and you already own Ant Empire, you are eligible for a free key! Please join us in Discord and message Zenkar or Jayann for your free key today!  If you are a content creator interested in doing key giveaways on your channel, contact us in Discord and we will be happy to provide you some additional keys.https://discord.gg/mKhzs8ytap

It's a game as old as time but with a goosey modern twist. Dozens, and even hundreds of items spawn and drop into various containers. Your challenge? To accurately guess the number of items inside each container. The game is easy to play but difficult to master.

This game features:
Realistic 3D arts & sound

 True to life physics
 A detailed tracking system
 Over 40 minutes of original goose themed music
 3 modes of play (freeplay, practice and leaderboard)
 4 levels of difficulty (simple, moderate, challenging and goosey)

The following features will be expanded upon in future updates:

 19 items
 21 containers
 2 unique scene settings

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2258090/Goosey_Guess/

notes.title: New Features Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I have been busy creating some more features and mechanics the last few weeks for Ant Empire, and am ready to share these.


    3 "Traits" have been created for each species
    6 New Research Upgrades (32 total)
    2 New Perks (12 total)
    1 New Map (5 total)
    1 New Colony Focus
    Influence Re-work




Traits

Sugar
Food Trackers - Minor and major workers have a 2% chance to eat enemy food while attacking
Polygynists - The Polygyne research is completed
Storage Experts - Food storage costs are reduced by 20%

Fire
Formic Acid - Soldiers and Super Soldiers have a 4% chance to lower enemy production
Twin Soldiers - Soldiers have a 3% chance of being born with a twin
Ruthless - Starts with Return Attacker 2

Carpenter
Resourceful - Bonus tiles cost the same as regular tiles
Offensive Defense - Nests recieve a 2% bonus to defense while attacking
Nuisance - New nests start with 11 influence
 
Leafcutter
Fungus Gardens - Colony grows fungus automatically from nest size
Tunnel Bandits - Soldiers and Super Soldiers have a 4% chance to reduce enemy colony's nest size
Nest Specialists - Nests can grow larger by 15 cubic centimeters

Army
Genesis - Soldiers have a 2% chance of mutating into a princess while hatching
Relocate Bivouac - Bivouacs can be relocated using influence and gain permanent bonuses
Territorial - Tiles can't be flipped by enemies and cannot claim tiles



Research

Queen Comfort - Gain Production from stored food
Workforce - Workers cost less influence to purchase
Renown - Each Princess gives an attack bonus
Clout - Queens generate influence
Variable Diet - Workers that are foraging have a chance to eat without using stored food
Outposts - Each tile owned in excess of 20 gives a small amount of production



Perks

Influential - Gain range when claiming tiles for the Colony
Add Queen - Adds a Queen to the Colony (also requires 2 princesses and Polygyne)



New Map

Farm has been added as the 5th map, and the 2nd map that is for 3-players.



Colony Focus

Colony Pride has been added as a focus, increasing all influence gained by 15%.



Influence Re-work

Currently, Influence is used for claiming tiles and removing enemy claims on the map. Workers can now be purchased at the cost of influence. 

Princesses also give influence each turn, and give less production.


There are tons of other changes and updates, but those are some of the more notable ones. Thanks for everyone's support!
